title: feat(rival8): display the eight F_cut 1-site filler remaining-bit tuples
science: The taxonomy that SUBSUMES #6402/#6403/#6404/#6405: it lists all eight F_cut 1-site fillers explicitly as (wt1,opp2,adj2,vertex3,mixed3) tuples, and the list is exactly wt1=1, adj2=1 with (opp2,vertex3,mixed3) running over all 2^3 combinations - i.e. the filler set is a 3-dimensional coordinate subcube, N_distinct=8, adj2=1 universally, exactly one row equals L1's (1,0,1,1,1). If only one member of the #6402-#6405 sub-series is kept, this is the one.
